title: Google Takes AI Mode Ads Worldwide as Search Growth Cools
dek: Ads inside Google's AI answers expand globally as search revenue slows.

facts.label: Search revenue growth in Q3, down from 19%
Drop in Alphabet shares after results

caption:
Those helpful AI answers in Google Search are about to come with ads, and not just in the U.S. 👀

During Alphabet's Q3 earnings call, Google said ads in AI Overviews and AI Mode are expanding to international markets. It's the first time Google is monetizing AI Search globally. Multi-turn ads, which follow you as you refine a question, are also rolling out in the U.S.

Why now? Search revenue growth slowed to 12%, down from 17% last quarter and 19% the quarter before. Google claims AI Mode ad click-through rates already match organic listings, but no outside data backs that up yet. Shares fell about 8% even with revenue up 25% to $127.6B.

At AI Parabellum, we'll be watching whether shoppers trust sponsored picks inside AI answers. Tip: always check for the sponsored label before you click.

post_caption:
Your next AI Mode answer might be an ad. Google is taking sponsored results inside AI Search global, betting they can make up for search revenue growth that has slid from 19% to 12% this year.

Good news for advertisers chasing long, detailed queries. For everyone else, keep an eye out for that sponsored label.
